mupen64plusAssessment.integrationCost: not-assessed — Mupen64Plus is not installed on the development machine

recommendation.reasoning: B26 via env-server is proven working for RL training. Local throughput is 8,598 steps/sec; remote single-instance is 1,482 steps/sec; 8 concurrent instances achieve 5,083 aggregate steps/sec. The WebSocket overhead is ~6x vs local, but multi-instance parallelism recovers aggregate throughput. For B26 training, this is sufficient. N64 targets require external dependencies (ROM files, N64Wasm dist, Mupen64Plus) not yet available — those benchmarks and the runtime decision for emulator targets are deferred.
